descriptions.text: A flaw in Nomic’s forwarding logic minted 40.65 unbacked nBTC and left Osmosis allBTC about $3.15 million short. Osmosis froze 22.65 allBTC, but roughly 18 BTC-equivalent had already reached Tornado Cash before the 74-day-delayed discovery.

A June 25 Nomic forwarding bug minted 40.650602 nBTC without BTC backing and left Osmosis allBTC short until a September freeze and recovery proposal. A public forensic reconstruction attributes the mint to a Nomic forwarding path that did not verify packet sender authorization and allowed escrow balance aliasing, so 25 self-referential ICS-20 packets minted nBTC without consuming new BTC backing.
